thread:
alice: quick idea — add a --change-window flag to the deploy bot so we can mark release windows in the audit log and automatically block noisy rollouts outside windows. also want an auto-pin-on-canary option (pin after N successful canaries) and a one-line /rollback command for hotfixes. thoughts?

bob: +1 on change-window. currently we manually add a note to tickets which gets lost. could be used to gate non-critical deploys.

carol: auto-pin-on-canary is nice but we need guardrails — ensure it only pins if post-deploy smoke checks pass and no new errors hit SLOs during the canary period. also: we should make the rollback command a fast path that accepts reason and incident link.

dan: sketch of CLI flags for discussion:
```
/deploy service=web version=v1.2.3 --canary=5 --auto-pin=on --change-window="23:00-01:00 UTC" --dry-run
/rollback service=web --to=previous --reason="5xx spike" --incident=INC-1234
```

ellie: for auto-pin, consider a cooldown so we don't re-pin repeatedly during quick rollouts. maybe add `pin_ttl` and `pin-owner` metadata.

alice: good call on smoke checks. propose adding a small post-deploy job that runs sanity endpoints + a lightweight load profile. if it fails we auto-abort pin and run rollback.

deploy-bot: @alice received deploy request (service=web, version=v1.2.3). queued canary=5. will run smoke checks after each canary batch. to cancel: `/deploy cancel 1779991111`.

bob: suggest adding metrics thresholds to trigger rollback, e.g. `5xx_rate > 0.5%` OR `p95_latency > 1000ms` for the canary window. store these thresholds in the service deploy config.

carol: sample deploy config (yaml) for ops team: 
```
deploy_bot:
  auto_pin_on_canary: true
  canary_count: 5
  canary_success_threshold: 4
  smoke_checks:
    - /health
    - /ready
  rollback_triggers:
    - name: high_error_rate
      expr: "rate(http_server_errors[1m]) > 0.005"
    - name: slow_p95
      expr: "histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[1m])) > 1.0"
  change_window: "23:00-01:00 UTC"
```

dan: for release notes templates — small JSON blob in repo with sections: summary, risk, rollback-plan, infra-changes, post-deploy-tasks. CLI can auto-populate from PR body and prompt for missing fields.

ellie: + :thumbsup: on the template. also can we add a `/deploy preview` that prints the generated release notes and expected fallout for approvers?

alice: next steps: dan + carol to draft config + CLI flags; bob will add threshold fields to service schema; ellie will prototype release-notes preview. aim for a small rollout next week behind `--dry-run` only.

deploy-bot: scheduled: 2026-05-06T23:00:00Z — dry-run hook for new flags enabled on staging. reminders will be posted in #eng-releases 30m before.

bob: sounds good, I can help run the dry-run and validate smoke-check reports.

carol: I'll add the abort hook and a sanity playbook snippet for on-call.

alice: cool — thanks all. filing a tiny RFC in the repo and linking it here when done. :party_popper:
